title: Events & Workshops
readOnlyHint: Your subscription is read-only — reactivate to manage events.

noAccess.title: You don't have access to events
noAccess.hint: Ask a manager to grant you the Events permission.

empty.upcomingHint: Create your first event — guests will see it on their Events tile as soon as you publish it.
empty.pastHint: Completed events will show up here automatically once their date passes.
empty.cancelledHint: Events you cancel will appear here along with the reason you gave.

names.moreLanguagesHint: Guests using these languages see English until you translate.
names.help: Arabic and English are required; other languages fall back to English.

form.photoHint: PNG, JPEG or WebP up to 5 MB. Shown on the guest Events tile — good photos sell.
form.photoInvalid: Choose a PNG, JPEG or WebP image up to 5 MB.
form.safeEditNote: This event is live — guests may already be booked against it. Schedule, price, pricing mode, location and the Hotel Info link are locked to protect their bookings; you can still edit the title, description, photo, and raise the capacity. Cancel it and create a new event for bigger changes.
form.endHint: Leave both empty for an open-ended event.
form.endIncomplete: Set both an end date and an end time, or leave both empty.
form.infoEntryHint: Adds a “Details” chip guests can tap for more, e.g. the pool's opening hours.
form.capacityDecreaseError: This event is live — capacity can only be raised, not lowered below {current}.
form.priceHint: In your hotel currency. 0 is a valid free-event price.

publish.title: Publish event
publish.body: Guests will be able to see and book this event as soon as it's published.

cancel.title: Cancel event
cancel.consequence: {count, plural, =0 {No guests have booked this event yet — cancelling won't notify anyone.} one {# guest has booked this event. Their booking will be cancelled and they'll be notified automatically.} other {# guests have booked this event. Their bookings will be cancelled and they'll be notified automatically.}} This can't be undone.
